annotations.title: Check if an issue is really fixed

description: After deploying a fix: re-checks uptime issues now (at most once every 30 seconds per app). For errors, compares the rate since the latest deploy with the error's normal rate: fixed, not fixed, or inconclusive (with how long to wait, or what's missing). No write access needed.
name: verify_fix
title: Check if an issue is really fixed
